candidate_units.form: prescript, expanded truth-love rationale, and grace-mercy-peace greeting
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: elder/addressee opening continues through the truth-remains rationale into the greeting framed by truth and love
candidate_units.preference_basis: Address, love-in-truth qualification, enduring-truth rationale, and greeting form one expanded opening; v4 begins the body joy report.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Splitting the address from its rationale invites identity or authorship reconstruction; isolating v3 invites Christological or doctrinal extraction; widening through v4 obscures the opening-to-body transition.

candidate_units.form: joy report, old mutual-love command, and recursive command definition
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: walking-in-truth joy moves to the not-new command to love and closes by defining love and commandment through walking
candidate_units.preference_basis: The positive walking report and command-definition chain cohere; v7's causal warning opens a new movement while depending on this frame.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Separating v5 from v6 detaches command from definition; isolating v4 turns report into identity evidence; absorbing v7 makes the warning part of the command definition.

candidate_units.form: deceiver rationale, self-watch warning, abiding contrast, and conditional reception case with consequence
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: the causal deceiver ground leads to watchfulness and the remain/not-remain test, then to an if-anyone reception case completed by v11
candidate_units.preference_basis: Causal warning, self-watch consequence, abiding contrast, and concrete conditional case form one warning-plus-grounds/instruction whole; the vv9/10 finer seam remains deferred.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Atomizing vv7-9 can select opponent identity, textual reading, Christology, or assurance; detaching vv10-11 can turn a bounded case into general hospitality, church-discipline, or greeting policy.

candidate_units.form: writing-medium transition, face-to-face intention, and final greeting
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: paper-and-ink restraint and intended face-to-face speech with full-joy purpose lead into the final greeting
candidate_units.preference_basis: Medium-change close and greeting jointly complete the letter; the conditional warning reached its stated consequence in v11.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Isolating v13 encourages addressee, location, or kinship reconstruction; merging vv10-13 blurs instruction and close; the medium contrast must not become chronology or authorship evidence.

hardest_seams.why: Greeting closes in v3 and joy report opens in v4, but truth/walking link them; preserve 1-3 and 4-6 while retaining 1-4.
The causal warning depends on the truth-love frame but shifts into warning/instruction; retain 4-6/7-11 and the larger 4-11 route.
The abiding contrast supplies the criterion for the conditional case, while v10 begins an if-anyone scenario; prefer 7-11 and defer 7-9/10-11.
Participation consequence closes the case and writing-medium transition opens the close; retain the seam without converting either side into policy or biography.
Writing intention and greeting are distinguishable but jointly complete the letter; prefer the larger close and retain the finer route.

premortem: Do not retain a one-chapter fallback or split verse by verse; preserve four larger form units unless governed review supplies stronger evidence.
Do not detach prescript from rationale/greeting, command from definition, warning from grounds/instruction, conditional case from consequence, or writing intention from greeting.
Do not turn internal-Bible or Johannine parallels into dependence, authorship, identity, opponent, Christology, canon, doctrine, theology, graph, retrieval, or boundary truth.
Do not let Second Temple, Greco-Roman, later rabbinic, or patristic evidence override the local text or establish setting, source, date, policy, attribution, reading, or seams.
Do not decide identities, authorship, date, location, source/dependence, variants, genitive, confession wording, Christology, assurance, chronology, canon, doctrine, or theology.
Do not universalize 2John.1.10-11 into hospitality, greeting, exclusion, discipline, church, household, or platform policy.
Keep every route LOW, deferred, candidate-only, non-authorizing, and without forced consensus; exact alternatives remain live.
